in_hebrew.name: Lorine
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Light, pure, and beautiful
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lorine הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'loros', which means 'maiden, or young woman'. In Greek mythology, Loros was the name of a goddess of light and beauty. In Christianity, the name Lorine is a variation of the biblical name 'Laura', which means 'bay leaf' or 'the crowned one'. This name carries the symbolism of light, purity, and beauty.
